title: The beautiful names of Allah – Al-Asma’ al-Husna
intro: Allah has revealed His most beautiful names to us – so that we may know Him and call on Him by them.

learn.text: And to Allah belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names. They will be recompensed for what they have been doing.

learn.html: God’s own name is Allah. It means the One and Only God, the Creator and Ruler of everything that exists. The name Allah is mentioned in the Qur’an 2,698 times. Besides this name, which is mentioned most, Allah has other beautiful names, which we call al-asma’ al-husna.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “Allah has ninety-nine names, one less than a hundred. Whoever knows them (understands what they mean and lives by them) will enter Jannah.” (Bukhari)

Understanding Allah’s names also means understanding that people, too, can be merciful, gentle, truthful, fair and generous, and can forgive one another. Allah is our greatest Helper, Protector and Benefactor, who gives life and death. He accepts our sincere repentance and answers our prayers.
When the Companions told Muhammad (SAW) that they wanted to know Allah, Surah Al-Ikhlas was revealed:

learn.text: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

items: Names of beauty (asma’ al-jamal) – about His mercy and forgiveness, for example Ar-Rahman (the Entirely Merciful), Ar-Rahim (the Especially Merciful), Al-Karim (the Generous), Al-Ghaffar (the One who forgives again and again).
Names of majesty (asma’ al-jalal) – about His justice, judgement and strictness, for example Al-‘Adl (the Just), Al-‘Aziz (the Almighty), Sari‘ al-Hisab (the One who is swift in taking account).

learn.title: Calling on Allah by His names
learn.html: Out of His endless mercy, Allah has shown us His names so that we turn to Him in du‘a with them. When we ask for mercy we call: Ya Rahman, ya Rahim; when we ask for forgiveness: Ya Ghaffar; when we ask for provision: Ya Razzaq.

items: Allah – Allah is One, there is no god besides Him
Ar-Rahman – the Entirely Merciful, whose mercy embraces all creation
Ar-Rahim – the Especially Merciful, rich in mercy towards the believers
Al-Malik – the King, who has complete dominion
Al-Quddus – the Holy, the Pure, free from every imperfection
As-Salam – the Source of peace
Al-Mu’min – the Giver of safety, who gives peace, safety and protection
Al-Muhaymin – the Guardian, who watches over His creation
Al-‘Aziz – the Almighty, who has the greatest strength
Al-Jabbar – the Compeller, by whose will everything happens
Al-Mutakabbir – the Supreme, unique in His greatness
Al-Khaliq – the Creator, who created the universe and everything in it
Al-Bari’ – the Maker, who creates from nothing
Al-Musawwir – the Fashioner, who gives His creation its shapes and forms
Al-Ghaffar – who forgives His servants again and again
Al-Qahhar – the Subduer, whose power always prevails
Al-Wahhab – the Bestower, who gives without limit
Ar-Razzaq – the Provider, who never stops giving provision to His creation
Al-Fattah – the Opener, who opens everything and eases His servants’ difficulties
Al-‘Alim – the All-Knowing, who knows what His creation does not; nothing happens without His knowledge

learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) recommended: “Whoever recites the last ayat of Surah Al-Hashr during the night or the day, and dies that night or that day, Allah will grant him Jannah.” <small>(Bayhaqi)</small>

learn.text: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him. He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
